deployments_detail.use: Avikus AI-based autonomous navigation systems (HiNAS) for commercial vessels; over 700 units in total orders including 300+ HD Hyundai newbuilds and 100+ retrofits, plus a landmark deal to equip 40 HMM vessels. [Avikus (HD Hyundai subsidiary), HiNAS Control]
deployments_detail.value: 700+ units in total orders; 40 HMM vessels

deployments_detail.use: Real-X powered unmanned autonomous excavator deployed by HD Hyundai XiteSolution/Site Solution; first autonomous excavator delivered, performs preset tasks without operator fatigue. [HD Hyundai XiteSolution, Real-X platform]

Integrated Smartship Solution (ISS) / AI-based ship management system that monitors condition of onboard equipment from engine to fuel supply, enabling one-click analysis and predictive maintenance of marine systems. [HD Hyundai Marine Solution]

AI-powered digital shipyard / Industrial Metaverse using Siemens Xcelerator and Digital Twin Composer, connecting ship design through production across HD Hyundai's global shipyards (targeted completion 2030), with Nvidia collaboration on digital twin. [Siemens Xcelerator, Nvidia Omniverse]

Joint development with Naver Cloud of a shipbuilding-specific AI ecosystem: cloud infrastructure, AI factory with GPU infrastructure and private cloud, training AI on 200M+ shipbuilding/offshore documents to optimize ship design and modeling. [Naver Cloud (HyperCLOVA)]

Humanoid welding robots for shipbuilding automation, jointly developed with Persona AI and HD Hyundai Robotics; bipedal robot to perform welding in shipyards, currently in verification phase targeting commercialization by 2027. [Persona AI, HD Hyundai Robotics]

AI-based structural analysis and ship design optimization solution jointly developed by HD Hyundai Samho and Korean Register (KR): determines number/position of hull supports and automates structural assessment; year-long joint project completed. [Korean Register (KR), HD Hyundai Samho]
Partnership with Altair to apply AI to optimize the performance of eco-friendly marine engines and explore AI potential in marine technology. [Altair]
AI-powered shipbuilding with digital twin and robotics technologies
Humanoid welding robots for shipbuilding automation [Persona AI]
Industry-specific AI (ASI) strategy; CAIO + AIX Promotion Office; AI Shipyard (200M+ datasets w/ Naver) across shipbuilding/energy/machinery

Group-wide deployment of Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) across HD Hyundai business units, including establishing a Center of Excellence for Foundry and AIP for shipbuilding and marine operations. [Palantir (Foundry, AIP)]

HiCAMS (HD Hyundai intelligent Camera based Alarm Monitoring System) uses onboard CCTV and AI algorithms to detect and analyze safety-related events (fire, personnel hazards) in real time at shipyards and on vessels; officially launched. [HD Hyundai (in-house)]
Generative AI service for after-sales calls at construction equipment division [Google Cloud]
